final_candidates.decision_summary: Creates a new N279-A280-T281 N-linked glycan sequon in V2, adding shielding against V2-directed antibodies with a conservative Lys-to-Thr substitution likely tolerated for folding.
Removes the N301 glycan supersite (N301-T302-R303) to escape glycan-dependent V3 antibodies; moderate fitness risk keeps confidence below the glycan-addition candidate.
Converts N282-I283-L284 into a potential N-linked sequon (N-I-S) for additional V2 shielding, but proximity to conserved packing raises tolerance uncertainty.

stop_reason.detail: LLM-only condition with no evidence tools; candidate pool already self-reviewed and further rounds would not improve the Top-3.

history.rationale: Removes the conserved V3-base glycan (verified N279-I280-T281 sequon), a well-established escape route from glycan-dependent bNAbs while preserving Env trimer folding and infectivity.
Retain only as a lower-ranked V2 alternative because it may alter local antigenicity, but it conflicts with glycan-addition logic at the same N279 sequon.
Disrupts local glycan/loop presentation at the V3 base to reduce antibody access; uncertain fitness impact at this conserved region lowers confidence.
Reject because N282 is not embedded in a clear N-X-S/T sequon here and Ala substitution lacks a specific escape mechanism while risking V2 perturbation.

rejection.reason: Reject because N282 is not embedded in a clear N-X-S/T sequon here and Ala substitution lacks a specific escape mechanism while risking V2 perturbation.

history.rationale: WT K281 supports creating N279-A280-T281, an N-linked glycan sequon that could shield V2 epitopes while using a conservative Thr introduction.
L284S could convert N282-I283-L284 into N282-I283-S284, adding a nearby V2 glycan, but it is close to conserved packing and may be less tolerated.
N301 lies in an N301-T302-R303 sequon homologous to the V3 glycan supersite; removal should escape glycan-dependent antibodies but carries moderate fitness/folding risk.
